A spreadsheet cell is a domain authority only when a project/module fact-class contract explicitly assigns it.
Slack is authoritative for the statement, not automatically for the real-world fact asserted by the statement.
Discord is authoritative for the statement, not automatically for the real-world fact asserted by the statement.
Email is authoritative for the communication, not automatically for the underlying domain fact.
